title: City Council District 2
statement: As we review the remediation completion and construction milestone for the Baylight District, I want to emphasize the importance of continued oversight and community engagement to ensure this project benefits the entire community, particularly Jack London and Downtown Oakland. I am pleased to see the soil test verification complete and Phase II remediation proceeding with independent oversight. I will closely monitor the progress, prioritizing economic momentum and public safety, and expect a detailed report on the project's status at our next meeting.
